`final class VulkanBorrowedTexture`<br/>
**Extends:** [`BorrowedTexture<VulkanImage>`](/reference/bridges/borrowedtexture/)<br/>

**Package:** `dev.joid.backend.vulkan.render.texture` · **Module:** `backend-vulkan` · **Source:** [VulkanBorrowedTexture.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/backend/vulkan/src/main/java/dev/joid/backend/vulkan/render/texture/VulkanBorrowedTexture.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">Vulkan</span>

An image of the host, by image view, that JOID samples without owning it.

## Description

The image must be in `SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL` when JOID samples it.

## Creation details

<a id="VulkanBorrowedTexture-factory-of"></a>

### of

`VulkanBorrowedTexture of(VulkanImage image)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Wraps that image.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when the Vulkan backend is not registered.

`VulkanBorrowedTexture of(Supplier<VulkanImage> image)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Wraps the image that the supplier returns, read again at each use, for a host that recreates its image.
Throws an `IllegalStateException` when the Vulkan backend is not registered.

## Method details

<a id="VulkanBorrowedTexture-method-getView"></a>

### getView

`long getView()` 

Returns the view of the current image; when the supplier returns another image, forgets the descriptor sets of the previous view.
